page_title: MNT 2-2 LIL | Montpellier v Lille 01/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+16' That's it for today, Benoit Millot has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+13' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
90+9' Mitchel Bakker (Lille) leaves his team at a huge disadvantage as he is sent off.
90+9' Benoit Millot interrupts the game and gives a red card to Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier). His manager is really frustrated at the moment.
90+6' No handball! Referee Benoit Millot points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Montpellier players celebrate.
90+4' The Montpellier players halt their celebrations as referee Benoit Millot makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a handball in the build-up play.
90+3' 2 - 2 Goal! Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:2.
90+3' One of the players from Montpellier times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+2' The ball possession at the moment is 42:58.
90' 14 additional min. will be played.
90' That's the end of the game for Mathias Fernandez-Pardo, who is replaced by Thomas Meunier (Lille).
90' Substitution. Jonathan David will be replaced by Mohamed Bayo (Lille).
89' Benoit Millot shows the yellow card to Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) for a heavy challenge.
88' Jean-Louis Gasset has decided to make a change. Gabriel Bares (Montpellier) replaces Nikola Maksimovic.
86' Referee Benoit Millot has finally had enough of Jean-Louis Gasset and gives him a straight RED CARD!
83' Modibo Sagnan (Montpellier) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
81' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Teji Savanier (Montpellier) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Tanguy Coulibaly.
80' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Teji Savanier (Montpellier), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
80' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Montpellier force their opponents to concede a corner.
77' Substitution. Mitchel Bakker makes way for Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille).
76' The game is interrupted now, Teji Savanier (Montpellier) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
76' Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
74' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.

72' What a great touch by Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier)! He picks up a precise pass inside the box and immediately produces a shot towards the net. Unfortunately for him, his bullet only crashes against the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lille.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ngalayel Mukau departs the field of play to be replaced by Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille).
68' Bruno Genesio prepares a substitution. Remy Cabella is replaced by Osame Sahraoui (Lille).
68' Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
67' Neat passing move from Montpellier in order to create new attacking opportunities.
63' Here comes a substitution. Becir Omeragic is given a rest as he is replaced by Modibo Sagnan (Montpellier).
63' Jean-Louis Gasset has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Junior Ndiaye (Montpellier) replacing Wahbi Khazri.
63' Substitution. Rabby Nzingoula (Montpellier) replaces Jordan Ferri.
59' 33:67 – the ratio of ball possession.
54' 1 - 2 Goal! Jonathan David (Lille) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Benjamin Lecomte into the top right corner.
54' Jonathan David (Lille) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
54' It’s a PENALTY to Lille after the VAR review!
52' The referee gives a yellow card to Remy Cabella (Lille).
52' Benoit Millot rightly pulls out a yellow card and shows it to Teji Savanier (Montpellier).

50' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Lille.
50' PENALTY APPEAL after Remy Cabella (Lille) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
47' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Alexsandro (Lille) was quite harsh and Benoit Millot didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+2' 1 - 1 Goal! Teji Savanier sent in a fine cross from the corner kick. The perfect pass found Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) and his bullet header from around the penalty spot went straight into the roof of the net. The score is 1:1.
45+1' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) is about to take a corner kick.
45+1' The corner kick from Teji Savanier (Montpellier) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' 0 - 1 Goal! Jonathan David (Lille) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Benjamin Lecomte to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
43' Jonathan David (Lille) is going to take the penalty!
42' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) jumps into a tackle and Benoit Millot signals a foul. PENALTY to Lille!
42' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
41' Jonathan David (Lille) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
39' Mitchel Bakker (Lille) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
37' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) launches a cross from the corner, but Benjamin Lecomte is alert to thwart the effort.

37' Mitchel Bakker (Lille) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Lille force a corner. They send men into the box.
36' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) will take the free kick.
35' Enzo Tchato (Montpellier) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Benoit Millot had an easy-decision to make.
31' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) takes the corner kick, but Benjamin Lecomte reads it well and stops the effort.
31' Mitchel Bakker (Lille) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lille.
30' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Remy Cabella (Lille).
26' Ngalayel Mukau (Lille) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Benoit Millot ignores the protests.
25' 4:2 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
23' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
23' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

22' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
20' Jonathan David (Lille) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
19' A pass into the penalty area from Jonathan David (Lille) is intercepted by the defence.
17' Jonathan David (Lille) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
16' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
15' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post.
14' Benjamin Andre (Lille) commits a rough challenge and Benoit Millot blows his whistle for an infringement.
13' The Lille players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
9' Benoit Millot shows a yellow card to Nikola Maksimovic (Montpellier) for his blatant foul.
5' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
4' Mitchel Bakker (Lille) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Montpellier will take the kick-off.
Benoit Millot is the one to supervise the game today.
